entities.summary: Eldiguzid, a notable figure in the history of Azerbaijan, associated with Seljuk and Atabeg Period (1136–1225). Preceded by Eldiguzid capital Tabriz becomes a major commercial and cultural center and Great Seljuk. Their legacy influenced Nizami Ganjavi composes the Khamsa, a masterwork of Persian literature and Hulagu Khan establishes the Ilkhanate with Tabriz as capital.
